summary: Backend+frontend integration tested for practice calls, WebRTC signaling, captions, and call UI flows using current QA1/QA2 accounts on public preview. Core practice/call flows pass; local caption speech inference flow fails to emit detected speech/caption events.

critical.issue: With real speech WAV fixture (Open Speech Repository, resampled PCM16k), response is 200 but returns {ok:true, speech_detected:false}; no call_caption events emitted to participants despite connected call and both caption consents enabled.

ui_bugs.issue: React DOM warning toast appeared during call flow: 'Received false for a non-boolean attribute ... accessible'.

integration_issues.issue: UI shows 'Listening · captions appear in your native language' after both users enable consent, but translated caption text could not be validated from backend due speech_detected=false on audio endpoint runtime test.

action_items: Fix local caption pipeline so real speech PCM returns speech_detected=true and emits call_caption events per listener target language.
Inspect caption_engine filtering path (segment no_speech_prob gate and text assembly) because faster_whisper detects language en in logs but endpoint still returns speech_detected=false.
Investigate and remove non-boolean DOM attribute warning ('accessible=false' path) in call UI render tree.
Re-test unverified backend scopes: practice direct-call blocked/self/unavailable matrix, queue expiration TTL behavior, room RTC membership relay guards under this QA dataset.
critical_code_review_comments: caption_engine.process() can return None even after language detection log appears; likely all segments filtered by `s.no_speech_prob < 0.7` predicate causing silent drop of transcripts.
Call flow state machine behaved correctly in runtime: answer alone did not activate captions; only after both call_media_ready events did caption status become active.

success_rate.frontend: 88% (major requested call/navigation checks passed; caption text-language emission not verified due backend failure)

seed_data_creation: No new user created. Temporary QA1/QA2 language changes (bn/es) were restored in test teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two isolated browser contexts are supported via `page.context.browser.new_context()` in this environment. Verified: Chats shortcut now has `chats-shortcut-call`, premium shortcut absent, Pro unchanged; call availability toggle works; random search/cancel path reachable; decline and second call flows pass; timer hidden during ringing and visible after connected; mute status updates. Weekly Moments Report header wraps naturally at 320 (height 48) and fits single line at 430 (height 24). Navbar labels not clipped at 320/430 in this run.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: (1) Login QA1+QA2, (2) create call and exchange offer/answer/media_ready, (3) enable caption consent on both, (4) POST valid octet-stream PCM16k speech fixture to /api/rtc/calls/{call_id}/audio. Observed: HTTP 200 with `{ok:true, speech_detected:false}`; no call_caption WS events. Backend logs show faster_whisper processed 2.2s audio and detected language 'en' with probability 0.58, indicating model execution happened but transcription output was dropped before publish. Likely cause is over-strict segment filtering (`no_speech_prob` threshold / text aggregation) returning empty text -> None. Mitigation: relax/inspect segment acceptance criteria, log segment text+probability, then re-run this test and assert speech_detected true with bn/es target outputs.
